'''Rho Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] squadron serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They fought rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. The squadron made use of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] [[starfighter]]s. At some point, the squadron was dispatched to an oceanic planet, with one member of the squadron releasing a barrage of missiles.
